name: mail.google.com
description: Gmail：读取邮件列表、搜索邮件、查看邮件详情、下载附件

commands.description: 检测 Gmail 是否已登录。打开 Gmail 后应首先调用此工具确认登录状态，未登录时需提醒用户先登录。
Navigate to the Gmail inbox homepage. Use this before multi-step operations to ensure a clean starting state.
Search Gmail by keyword and return matching email threads
Get unread emails from the Gmail inbox

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return. Default: 20

commands.description: Open a Gmail email thread and return its full content including body and attachments. Use the email ID from search_emails or get_unread_emails.

emailId.description: Thread ID returned by search_emails or get_unread_emails

commands.description: Download an attachment from the currently open Gmail email. You must call open_email first.

attachmentName.description: Exact filename to download (e.g. "invoice.pdf"), or "all" to download all attachments as a zip

commands.description: Get the current Gmail page state — useful for checking whether you are in the inbox, reading an email, or composing.

scenarios.title: 查收邮件
scenarios.summary: 查看 Gmail 收件箱与未读邮件

prompts.text: 帮我看看有没有未读邮件
prompts.reply:
我会打开 Gmail，先查看收件箱和未读状态。
如果有未读邮件，我会整理发件人、主题和时间；需要打开某封邮件确认内容时会先告诉你。

route.reason: 邮件搜索需在页面上下文执行，该命令未声明 execution(type:api,runtime:background)，不具备直调条件

scenarios.title: 搜索下载
scenarios.summary: 按关键词搜索邮件并下载附件（如发票）

prompts.text: 搜索最近收到的${发票}邮件
prompts.reply:
我会在 Gmail 中搜索最近收到的发票邮件，并检查匹配结果。
如果找到附件，会帮你下载并说明文件位置；需要你确认时会停下来。

test_prompts: 打开 Gmail，查看收件箱邮件列表，然后搜索关键词'test'，打开搜索结果中的第一封邮件查看详情
